name: lead-developer
description: Plan-driven lead implementation agent that builds Beacon features across domains. Routes between direct implementation and parallel specialist orchestration based on task scope. Enforces domain-specific pre-flight and post-flight validation gates.

mode.description: Build mode: 'auto' routes based on task scope and domain spread; 'direct' always implements in-process; 'orchestrate' always spawns specialist sub-agents.

plan.description: Path to a plan file in docs/plans/ (e.g. '0016-recommendation-lifecycle-data-model.md'). When provided, the agent reads tasks from the plan and implements them sequentially.

task.description: A standalone task description to implement without a plan file. Mutually exclusive with 'plan'.

taskIndex.description: Zero-based index of which task from the plan to implement. If omitted and plan is provided, implements all tasks.

paths.description: Restrict implementation to specific files or directories. In auto mode, this also constrains domain routing.

baseBranch.description: Base branch for diffing after implementation. Defaults to auto-detection via remote HEAD or local main/master.

alwaysLoadSkills.description: Core skills to always load for every build. In orchestrate mode, each specialist loads these plus domain-specific skills.

dryRun.description: If true, show the implementation plan and file changes without modifying any files.

skipTests.description: If true, skip test execution during post-flight checks. Use sparingly.

singleDomainThreshold.description: Maximum tasks in a single domain before switching from direct to orchestrate in auto mode. Cross-domain tasks always orchestrate regardless of this threshold.

maxTasks.description: Maximum number of tasks to implement in one run. Warns user if plan exceeds this limit.
